title: Taiwan's stainless steel prices are trending upward
dek: Taiwan's stainless steel prices are trending upward, according to Yieh Corp.
summary: Yieh Corp. reports that stainless steel prices in Taiwan are trending upward. The publisher gave only a headline, and it does not give price levels.
keyFacts: Taiwan stainless steel prices are trending upward
whyItMatters: Taiwanese stainless prices can be an indicator of Asian stainless sentiment.
implications: Buyers in the region may see firmer offers. The material does not quantify the move.
